entries.decision: Keep DRTIME10-002 as a confirmed TimeService V1.0 PDF/documentation defect and architecture/profile explanation, but do not create a standalone runtime matcher. The finding describes a bilingual omission on physical PDF page 6 and constrains interpretation of the SNTP/DNS-SD profile; it is not tied to an XML/XSD validation event or another discrete runtime message signature.
guards: physical page 6 and EV-147 evidence remain authoritative for the bilingual omission
TimeService V1.0 remains a non-XSD protocol/discovery profile
do not infer a generic cyclic UDP current-time broadcast from _ibisip_udp._udp
do not create a synthetic runtime error solely from the missing English sentence
do not latest-wins substitute a newer NTP standard for the VDV-selected RFC 4330 profile
retain the finding as explanatory/profile knowledge for SDK documentation and future source-locator output
